summary: Tabs feature implemented in the working tree but not executed. Changed: src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (new: Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs), src/textual/renderables/underline_bar.py (clickable_ranges, Text output), src/textual/renderables/opacity.py (style-preserving blend), tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py (one new test), tests/test_tabs.py (new), docs/reference/tabs.md (new), sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css (new). Layout resolver needed no change: Edge already has size, min_size=1, fraction=1. Judgment calls: bar position and animation use the displayed-tab index rather than the full-list index from find_tab_by_name, so duplicate names place the underline correctly; action_range_clicked is async to match repo convention; click action is range_clicked('<name>') with repr quoting for ast.literal_eval. Known limitation: a zero-width highlight (empty active label) suppresses underline click spans. Nothing committed; tests not run per instructions.
